definitions.explanation: A formal written work submitted as a requirement for an academic degree. Encompasses both master's theses and doctoral dissertations.

examples.japanese: {学位論文|がくいろんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: I've decided on the topic for my thesis.

examples.japanese: {学位論文|がくいろんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The thesis defense will be held next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{学位論文|がくいろんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{上|あ}げ→書き上げる：06978_kakiageru⟧、⟦{博士号|はくしごう}→博士号：16350_hakushigou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}した→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
examples.english: He spent three years writing his dissertation and earned his doctorate.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{学位|がくい}→学位：10196_gakui⟧ (academic degree) and ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧ (thesis, paper). The umbrella term for theses written to fulfill degree requirements at any level. In practice, ⟦{修士論文|しゅうしろんぶん}→修士論文：09968_shuushironbun⟧ (master's thesis) and ⟦{博士論文|はくしろんぶん}→博士論文：09969_hakushironbun⟧ (doctoral dissertation) are more specific and frequently used when the level is known.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学位論文|がくいろんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a thesis
- {学位論文|がくいろんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧: thesis examination/defense
- {学位論文|がくいろんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}する→執筆する：25397_shippitsusuru⟧: to write a thesis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{修士論文|しゅうしろんぶん}→修士論文：09968_shuushironbun⟧: master's thesis — specifically for the master's degree; often abbreviated as {修論|しゅうろん}
- ⟦{博士論文|はくしろんぶん}→博士論文：09969_hakushironbun⟧: doctoral dissertation — specifically for the doctoral degree; often abbreviated as {博論|はくろん}
- ⟦{卒業論文|そつぎょうろんぶん}→卒業論文：09259_sotsugyouronbun⟧: graduation thesis — the undergraduate thesis; abbreviated as ⟦{卒論|そつろん}→卒論：08606_sotsuron⟧
